Summary with extractive: The AIT academic year consists of two semesters: January and August. The January Semester/Term Intake has a deadline of 20 December for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa. The March Term Intake (only for Faculty of Business Management) has a deadline of 15 February for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa and 25 February for other applicants. The June Term Intake (only for Faculty of Business Management) has a deadline of 15 May for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa and 25 May for other applicants. The August Semester/Term Intake has a deadline of 28 February for HM King’s and Queen’s, and GMS scholarships, 31 March for other Scholarships (i.e. ADB-JSP, Bangchak: Master and Doctoral and others), 10 June for AIT Scholarships including RTG Fellowships, 30 June for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa, and 25 July for other applicants. The October Term Intake (only for Faculty of Business Management) has a deadline of 15 September for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa and 25 September for other applicants. The Admissions and Scholarships Unit can be contacted at P.O. Box 4, KlongLuang Pathumthani 1,2120 THAILAND, phone (662) 524 5024, and email admissions@ait.ac.th.

Linens provision and laundry service (2 bedsheets, 2 towels, and 1 Pillowcase) is provided except for Category 2 (Dorm E, J, K) and SV Married Units. Special accommodation facilities for disabled individuals are available, including 4 non-air-conditioned rooms in Dorm C and 4 air-conditioned rooms in Dorm X and Y.
